title: Scientific Notation: Large and Small Numbers
seo_title: Grade 8 Scientific Notation Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Compare and represent numbers in scientific notation; calculate using numbers in scientific notation, including very large and very small numbers.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 8 scientific notation worksheets: writing large and small numbers, changing back, ordering and calculating. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Scientific notation: a × 10ⁿ, where 1 ≤ a < 10.
  • Large numbers: 45 000 = 4,5 × 10⁴ (the comma moves 4 places).
  • Small numbers: 0,0032 = 3,2 × 10⁻³.
  • To compare, look at the powers of 10 first.

Examples

Example

(3 × 10⁴) × (2 × 10³)

3 × 2 = 6

10⁴ × 10³ = 10⁷

Answer: 6 × 10⁷

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
The first number too big45 × 10³ is not in scientific notation.
Counting zerosCount the places the comma moves.
The signSmall numbers have a negative exponent.

items.q: Work out (4,8 × 107) × (4 × 101). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 4,8 × 4 = 19,2. Add the powers: 7 + 1 = 8. 19,2 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 1,92 × 109.

items.q: Work out (8 × 100) × (1 × 103). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 8 × 1 = 8. Add the powers: 0 + 3 = 3. 8 × 103.

items.q: Work out (9 × 100) × (5 × 104). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 9 × 5 = 45. Add the powers: 0 + 4 = 4. 45 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 4,5 × 105.

items.q: Work out (3 × 107) × (8 × 104). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 3 × 8 = 24. Add the powers: 7 + 4 = 11. 24 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 2,4 × 1012.

items.q: Work out (6,9 × 107) × (8 × 103). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 6,9 × 8 = 55,2. Add the powers: 7 + 3 = 10. 55,2 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 5,52 × 1011.

items.q: Work out (8,1 × 10−3) × (2 × 104). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 8,1 × 2 = 16,2. Add the powers: −3 + 4 = 1. 16,2 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 1,62 × 102.

items.q: Work out (2 × 10−3) ÷ (2 × 10−3). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 2 ÷ 2 = 1. Subtract the powers: −3 − (−3) = 0. 1 × 100.

items.q: Work out (2,5 × 10−1) ÷ (2,5 × 101). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 2,5 ÷ 2,5 = 1. Subtract the powers: −1 − 1 = −2. 1 × 10−2.

items.q: Work out (3,4 × 106) × (5 × 104). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 3,4 × 5 = 17. Add the powers: 6 + 4 = 10. 17 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 1,7 × 1011.

items.q: Work out (9,2 × 101) × (7 × 10−4). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 9,2 × 7 = 64,4. Add the powers: 1 + (−4) = −3. 64,4 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 6,44 × 10−2.

items.q: Work out (5 × 108) ÷ (5 × 10−2). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 5 ÷ 5 = 1. Subtract the powers: 8 − (−2) = 10. 1 × 1010.

items.q: Work out (9 × 106) × (5 × 10−4). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 9 × 5 = 45. Add the powers: 6 + (−4) = 2. 45 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 4,5 × 103.

items.q: Work out (7 × 100) × (7 × 100). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 7 × 7 = 49. Add the powers: 0 + 0 = 0. 49 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 4,9 × 101.

items.q: Work out (4,375 × 10−4) ÷ (2,5 × 106). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 4,375 ÷ 2,5 = 1,75. Subtract the powers: −4 − 6 = −10. 1,75 × 10−10.

items.q: Work out (7,2 × 105) × (8 × 106). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 7,2 × 8 = 57,6. Add the powers: 5 + 6 = 11. 57,6 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 5,76 × 1012.

items.q: Work out (8,8 × 104) × (3 × 104). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 8,8 × 3 = 26,4. Add the powers: 4 + 4 = 8. 26,4 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 2,64 × 109.

items.q: Work out (9,1 × 102) × (2 × 10−2). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 9,1 × 2 = 18,2. Add the powers: 2 + (−2) = 0. 18,2 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 1,82 × 101.

items.q: Work out (9 × 104) × (8 × 10−4). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 9 × 8 = 72. Add the powers: 4 + (−4) = 0. 72 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 7,2 × 101.

items.q: Work out (7 × 10−4) ÷ (4 × 10−2). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 7 ÷ 4 = 1,75. Subtract the powers: −4 − (−2) = −2. 1,75 × 10−2.

items.q: Work out (9 × 10−4) × (6 × 10−3). Give your answer in scientific notation.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 9 × 6 = 54. Add the powers: −4 + (−3) = −7. 54 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 5,4 × 10−6.
